settings.title: It’s not the right fit if

You’re shopping for a sales pitch. There isn’t one.
You’d rather we did it all for you. Let’s talk instead.

settings.editor: Chris is the Owner and Digital Partner at First Search Marketing. He built the FirstSearch Framework from years of working with New Hampshire businesses, and he teaches it the same way he uses it with partners: plainly, practically and with real examples.

icon_list.text: Doors open 15 minutes before we start. Coffee is on.
Bring a laptop and your last three months of marketing numbers, if you have them.

settings.title: Good questions before you sign up.

tabs.tab_content: No. You’ll learn the same framework we use with partners and leave with a plan you can run yourself. If you want help afterwards, you know where we are.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need to prepare anything?
tabs.tab_content: Bring a laptop. If you have them, your last three months of marketing numbers (website visits, calls, leads) make the hands-on parts more useful.

tabs.tab_title: Can I bring someone from my team?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Add more seats in the registration form. Owners and the person who handles marketing get the most out of it together.

tabs.tab_title: What if I can’t make it?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM refund policy] Let us know up to [48 hours] before and we’ll move you to a future date. Everyone who registers gets the recording.

tabs.tab_title: Is it right for my industry?
tabs.tab_content: The framework works for any local, service-based business: trades, health and wellness, professional services, retail and more. The examples are all from New Hampshire businesses.
